title: Long-Term Outcomes and Prognostic Analysis of Endometrial Cancer: A 10-Year Tertiary Care Experience.
snippet: Endometrial carcinoma (EC) is a common gynecologic malignancy with rising incidence globally, including in low- and middle-income countries. Local data on clinicopathological characteristics, treatment patterns, and survival outcomes remain limited in Pakistan.
